task_title: A row inserted and deleted inside one commit window must not poison the change feed
task_criteria: A commit carrying both an insert record and its delete/tombstone record for the same table+key+contentHash must not fail replay: GET /api/ns/:ns/changes stays 200 and the next real change is delivered.
The falsifier holds: the new replay test fails against pre-fix replay.ts with CHANGELOG_CORRUPT and a closed subscription, and passes with the fix.
Integrity is not weakened: a single unresolved record (insert without tombstone, or a tombstone whose row never existed at the parent) still fails closed.
